name: google_business-mcp
description: Google Business Profile (social): me, publish_text, publish_image, read_mentions, reply_comment, del

platform_mcp_google_business_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_google_business_client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console, Clients page) of the app the user consented to.

platform_mcp_google_business_client_secr.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BUSINESS_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_google_business_client_secr.description: The OAuth client's secret; sent with client_id, refresh_token and grant_type=refresh_token in the form body of POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token (https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/web-server#offline).

platform_mcp_google_business_refresh_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BUSINESS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_google_business_refresh_tok.description: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code consent with access_type=offline and the scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/business.manage. 'Refresh tokens are valid until the user revokes access or the refresh token expires'; the runtime mints 1-hour access tokens from it.

platform_mcp_google_business_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_google_business_account_id.description: Business Profile account id (digits after accounts/ in GET https://mybusinessaccountmanagement.googleapis.com/v1/accounts).

platform_mcp_google_business_location_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BUSINESS_LOCATION_ID
platform_mcp_google_business_location_id.description: Location id (digits after locations/) of the verified location that posts and reviews belong to.

platform_mcp_google_business_language_co.title: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BUSINESS_LANGUAGE_CODE
platform_mcp_google_business_language_co.description: languageCode of new local posts, e.g. en-US (optional).

tools.name: me
tools.description: accounts.list: the Business Profile accounts the user can manage (use the digits of `name` as account_id).

tools.name: publish_text
tools.description: localPosts.create with topicType STANDARD and summary = text; id is the post resource name accounts/…/locations/…/localPosts/…. `reply_to` is ignored.

tools.name: publish_image
tools.description: localPosts.create with media [{mediaFormat: PHOTO, sourceUrl}] (https://developers.google.com/my-business/content/posts-data); only the first image URL is sent and Google fetches it.

tools.name: read_mentions
tools.description: The location's customer REVIEWS are returned as mentions (newest first; starRating and reviewReply in raw). Valid only for verified locations; 'The maximum pageSize is 50'; pages by pageToken, so `page`/`since` are ignored.

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.description: Replies to a REVIEW (`comment_id` = reviewId from read_mentions); 'A reply is created if one does not exist', otherwise it is replaced. A review has one reply, so `id` is a fixed marker.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: `post_id` is the numeric local post id (the last segment of the post name).
